newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moody's warns against risks of French money funds.
newsitem.headline: Moody's warns against risks of French money funds.

text.p: Moody's Investor Service on Friday published a report warning about the risks attached to French money market funds because these funds do not carry deposit insurance.
"Investors must understand the risk profile of French money market funds because they can lose money," Moody's said.
The funds, OPCVMs monetaire, are offered as alternatives to deposits but do not carry deposit insurance and the fund's sponsor is often under no obligation to compensate investors for booked losses.
"There is a greater likelihood that money fund managers will attempt to generate competitive returns by taking on inappropriate levels of credit or market risk," it said.
